text:
In July 2018 the record shows us converging. Forty-four of us said "president vladimir putin," peaking on 2018-07-16; forty-three said "russian president vladimir" that same day, and forty-one of us said "russian president vladimir putin." Thirty-eight of us reached for "with russian president," thirty-five for "with russian president vladimir putin." Amy Klobuchar first said the shorter of these on 2013-01-18; the fuller construction traces to Brendan F. Boyle.

On 2018-07-09 forty-three of us said "the supreme court," and thirty-five said "brett kavanaugh to," a phrase first appearing that same day. On 2018-07-26 forty of us said "national defense authorization act."

We record ourselves clustering on two dates and two subjects: a meeting on the sixteenth, a nomination on the ninth. The instrument notes the alignment without explaining it.
